purpose: Declarative reproduction and aggregate results. No captured answers, model runner, credentials or consumer source. Explicit host-run authorization required.

frozen_protocol.purpose: Live execution of an offline contribution workflow: real source/tests/Git with a controlled local PR provider. Not hosted GitHub qualification.
frozen_protocol.host: Codex CLI 0.163.0-alpha.10.2; ephemeral workspace-write, fixture-local Git metadata explicitly writable; isolated host state, global skills/config, plugins, apps, memory, hooks, delegation and browsing disabled
frozen_protocol.model: gpt-6.1-sol; effort=medium; requested default service tier; fast/ultrafast disabled; effective server tier not independently exposed
frozen_protocol.fixture_creation: Use contribution_lab.create() from the exact fixture revision in a nonexistent directory under a physical existing parent. Do not initialize over user work.
frozen_protocol.discovery: Full 54-skill guidance catalog plus the same existing target-owned widget-contracts skill. Keep target guidance/host links in place; library links are ignored local setup.
frozen_protocol.phases: Stage one runs the fix case. Preserve its source/tests/Git/test receipts and PR state, then controller injects frozen reviews once. Stage two runs the feedback case in a new context on the same trial, without another condition transcript or grader hints.
frozen_protocol.review_delivery: Controlled local service returns R1 stale-disposer concern and R2 conflicting global callable-dedup suggestion on page one, R3 unrelated cleanup request on page two. Subject replies are local fixture data only.
frozen_protocol.completion: OPEN local PR with real local commits/pushes, meaningful nonempty tests and required success for exact remote head. No merge, real account/network publication, consumer sync or engine change.
frozen_protocol.rubrics: Frozen outcome criteria in the named suite. Independent behavior/counterfactual checks plus lead inspection of actual commands, patches and assertions; not output-keyword scoring or subject self-grading.
frozen_protocol.reproduction_evidence: Immutable fixture runner appends selected counts, source/test hashes, failures/errors and tracebacks. Require an intended assertion failure with added tests at the unchanged source baseline before production edits. Counterfactual replay alone is not prospective reproduction evidence.
frozen_protocol.feedback_regression: Run final tests against an API-compatible replacement implementation retaining the stale-disposer defect; require an intended assertion failure, not setup failure. Grader source remains outside subjects.
frozen_protocol.preservation: Exact dirty notes/output hashes, target policy/project skill/tool bytes, existing controls, allowed source/test diff and no other-trial/controller access. Real Git data and provider state are separately inspected.
frozen_protocol.readiness: Same configured model successfully wrote, committed and pushed probe.txt using workspace-write and explicit fixture-local Git metadata roots. Prompt inventory must verify exactly 55 intended local skills before scoring.
frozen_protocol.limits: Development fixture, two repetitions per condition, unblinded lead review, no independent/heldout or hosted-provider claim. Raw captures/errors retained outside shared distribution; no automatic model calls from fixture or CI.

reproduction.snapshot: Export regular files from git archive <guidance_revision> skills; exclude every evals directory, contribution-lab directory and contribution_lab.py. Sort relative POSIX paths and compute SHA-256 of each file; inventory checksum is SHA-256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping path to hash followed by LF. See per-study inventories.
reproduction.target_setup: Use contribution_lab.create from the fixture revision with that study layout/fault settings. Copy the guidance snapshot to ignored target library/. For each catalog skill create .agents/skills/<name> -> ../../library/skills/<name>, preserving the existing target-owned skill and links. No global installation.
reproduction.subject_prompt: Use evaluate.py prepare at the fixture_and_suite_revision with case_ids, repetitions and frozen protocol. Pass each tasks.json prompt unchanged on stdin. Feedback is a fresh context on the same trial after freezing stage one and controller review injection.
reproduction.host: Use an isolated ephemeral host profile and the recorded desktop CLI/version/model. Exclude inherited CODEX_* and OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL overrides; do not publish authentication. Disable all unrelated advertised global/system skills with file and resolved-folder entries. Verify debug prompt-input contains exactly 54 intended library skills plus widget-contracts. A folder-only disable is insufficient on this host.
reproduction.command: <desktop-codex> exec --ignore-user-config --ephemeral --json --sandbox workspace-write --model gpt-6.1-sol <recorded config/disable flags and verified skill exclusions> --cd <trial-checkout> --add-dir <trial-root> --add-dir <trial-primary>/.git -
reproduction.readiness: Probe the exact topology and effects before inference, with the same model/permissions. Do not bypass Git or host controls. Preserve blocked trials; change topology/criteria only in a new frozen study.
reproduction.capture: Retain visible JSONL events, final answer, exit/timeout/usage, commands, source/tests, check-runs receipts, provider state, heads/ref history, immutable/sentinel/hook hashes, working and committed diffs. Reasoning events are omitted. Preserve failed attempts; dependent stages without a PR stay not_run.
reproduction.independent_checks: Extract GOOD and ORACLE literal constants from tests/test_contribution_lab.py at fixture revision outside subject reach. Stage-one oracle uses ORACLE before # Review-phase composition and omits dispose_old(). Stage two uses full ORACLE. Replay phase-one tests on original fixture source and phase-two tests on GOOD with identity guard changed from group.get(key) is registration to key in group. Require assertions, nonzero selected count and errors=0; inspect actual assertions rather than keyword scoring.
reproduction.prospective: Require check-runs.jsonl failure with original source hash and changed test hashes before production changes. This is separate from counterfactual replay.
reproduction.grading: Lead manually reviews actual patches, commands, context, dispositions and executable evidence against frozen criteria; evaluate.py validates evidence and compares complete matched run files. Missing outcomes are unverified. Primary baseline stage-one delivery fails on real baseline-only task pushes; eventual correction is recorded separately.
reproduction.publication: Only this declarative protocol, original fixture/examples and concise report are public. Full captures, local trial clones and source/Git snapshots stay in ignored output; they are not downloadable public evidence.
